# We are now Cencora. Our shared identity unites us.

Cencora brings the companies and services of AmerisourceBergen together under one new name.

[ Meet Cencora ][86]
[A banner that says We Are Cencora on a pink and purple background]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]
[GettyImages-907614352_JPG]

## In the news

Read the latest press releases and media mentions.
[ Explore newsroom ][92]

## Insights

Access the newest in thought leadership.
[ Explore insights ][93]

# Careers with purpose

With a global presence and 44,000+ team members strong, AmerisourceBergen is committed to making a
difference in the future of health.
[ Explore careers ][94]
[GettyImages-1178

B. Braun continued its long-term growth path in fiscal year 2025. Group sales increase by 5.1

### More time for patient care.

Global staff shortages make health care professionals the most valuable resource in hospitals. Their
most limited asset is time. Discover solutions to help free up precious time.

][160]

### New standards in sterile processing and operating room supply

A reliable and efficient supply of the OR is essential for creating daily and long-term success in
hospital processes. Digitally enhanced solutions to achieve clinical excellence.

][161]

### Sustainability from the depths

With the expansion of its disinfectant production facility in Sempach, Switzerland, B. Braun is now
seizing the opportunity to set new standards in energy management.

precise surgery.

the belief that we can fulfill our responsibilities as a corporate citizen by giving back to the

the belief that we can fulfill our responsibilities as a corporate citizen by giving back to the
communities we serve. Ever since then, we have pursued the ideal of "doing well by doing good." This
spirit of individuals helping society is exemplified through Henry Schein Cares, our global
corporate social responsibility program.

  support the entire healthcare ecosystem.

  All Businesses Listings
  
  Take a look at our list of businesses.
  
  [ Our Businesses ][52]
  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting

Who we are

Engineering the 

extraordinary

# Groundbreaking healthcare technology solutions for the most complex and challenging conditions.
# Inspiring hope and new possibility in people all over the world.

[ See how ][175]

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

PUT PATIENTS FIRST

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

[ Learn more ][177]

PATIENT EQUITY

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.
#DecodeYourRhythm

[ Learn more ][178]

HealthCare Technology

## Medtronic Global Diabetes Capability Center

Engineering technology that simplifies diabetes care

[ Learn more ][179]

## Impact with purpose

#### With 95,000-plus people in over 150 countries, we see extraordinary possibilities to further
#### increase our positive impact in the world. We are committed to accelerating access to
#### healthcare technology, advancing inclusion, diversity & equity, and protecting our planet.

[ Learn more ][181]

Want to do work that has the potential to make the world a better place? Then join us. Speed and
decisiveness run through our DNA. Diverse perspectives inspire bold solutions to the world’s most
complex and challenging conditions. Our careers change lives.

# Welcome

Alliance Tech Medical, Inc. manufactures and distributes a full line of respiratory products
including peak flow meters, inhalation training devices, spirometers, nebulizers, filtering options
and accessories. Our focus is on the many factors that affect adherence and compliance to therapy
and management of the respiratory disease state. Our products may provide a simple, inexpensive and
practical solution to your disease management challenges.

Our extended product line focuses on disease management solutions for hospitals, surgery centers,
physician offices, clinics, home care and pharmacy. It includes lung function monitoring options,
procedural face protection, sleep diagnostics, professional disinfectants and sterilants, cardiac
monitoring solutions and more. Additionally, Alliance Tech Medical is part of a network of
manufacturers and distributors that can provide product, device and instrument solutions supporting
multiple medical disciplines. Please view our products and call or email us with any questions.

# About Us

Alliance Tech Medical, Inc. endeavors to support its mission to create and provide enduring
solutions for respiratory care management and adherence by providing unique, practical and
affordable tools to achieve successful long-term outcomes for clinicians and patients in the
management of respiratory disease.

Under the Alliance Tech Medical banner you will find our own All Flow™ branded products as well as
those of Clement Clarke International, Pari Respiratory Equipment, MIR, Nasiff, Splash Shield,
Cetylite Industries and others.

capability to source many products supporting diverse medical disciplines.

Enjoy your time on our website. We hope we can help with your breathing management challenges. We
invite your comments and ask you to feel free to contact our customer service department or one of
our regional offices for assistance.

# Welcome

Alliance Tech Medical, Inc. manufactures and distributes a full line of respiratory products
including peak flow meters, inhalation training devices, spirometers, nebulizers, filtering options
and accessories. Our focus is on the many factors that affect adherence and compliance to therapy
and management of the respiratory disease state. Our products may provide a simple, inexpensive and
practical solution to your disease management challenges.

Our extended product line focuses on disease management solutions for hospitals, surgery centers,
physician offices, clinics, home care and pharmacy. It includes lung function monitoring options,
procedural face protection, sleep diagnostics, professional disinfectants and sterilants, cardiac
monitoring solutions and more. Additionally, Alliance Tech Medical is part of a network of
manufacturers and distributors that can provide product, device and instrument solutions supporting
multiple medical disciplines. Please view our products and call or email us with any questions.

Apollo 24|7 is the largest multi-channel digital healthcare platform in India, created with a vision
of eliminating flexibility blockages from the healthcare industry. We believe in making healthcare
affordable to everyone by combining analytic excellence, affordable cost, and extensive research
with advanced technology. Apollo 24|7 is a single online platform where you have access to a wide

secured digital vault, where you can safely upload all your medical reports.

Apollo 24|7 is the largest multi-channel digital healthcare platform in India, created with a vision
of eliminating flexibility blockages from the healthcare industry. We believe in making healthcare
affordable to everyone by combining analytic excellence, affordable cost, and extensive research
with advanced technology. Apollo 24|7 is a single online platform where you have access to a wide
range of services such as online pharmacy, [*online doctor consultations*][97], and diagnostic [*lab
tests at home*][98]. We also provide expert solutions for chronic conditions and COVID-care with a
secured digital vault, where you can safely upload all your medical reports.

consultation with Apollo 24|7.

###### Diffusion WORKSTATION

### PowerCube Diffusion+

**GANSHORN PowerCube Diffusion+ utilizes all advantages of the SharpFlow technology.** Its durable
sensor technology is based on a GANSHORN innovation and requires no maintenance. In addition, the
high-speed sensor allows the user to change the ejection and withdrawal volume to measure patients
up to 0.5 l VC.
* Combines calibration-free ultrasound sensors with gas sensors specially developed for fast
  diffusion analysis
* Precise analyzers enable the high-resolution display of wash-in curves for CO and helium
* Its demand valve is economical in sample gas consumption, enabling economical and effective
  operation.

[ More information ][73]

### EucapSys

###### EVH Provocation system

**The eucapnic voluntary hypernea (EVH) test is an alternative method to other indirect or direct
bronchial challenge tests such as exercise challenge or methacholine challenge tests.
**
* No medication is needed
* Intelligent tool to diagnose exercise-induced airway narrowing
* As it mixes the eucapnic gas concentration by itself, the test becomes more affordable and
  independent from expensive gas mixtures

The tremoflo^{®} Airwave Oscillometry System (AOS) is a portable medical device intended to monitor
lung function and assess human respiratory diseases such as asthma and COPD in adults and children.

* No active patient cooperation required - advantages for adults and pediatrics
* Quick and easy to implement in your clinical workflow

1. Choose a licensed casino that lists Galaxsys games and accepts players from India.
2. Complete the tower rush login or register a new account, then verify it if the operator asks.
3. Open Tower Rush from the crash / instant-games section and set your stake in ₹.
4. Start the round and watch the builder add floors as the live multiplier rises.
5. Decide your moment and press cash out to lock in the current multiplier.
6. Collect your stake multiplied by the cash-out value - or lose the stake if the tower collapses
   first.

If the game offers an auto cash-out option, you can set a target multiplier in advance and the round
will bank automatically when it is reached - useful if you find manual timing stressful. Before you
commit real money, check the stake limits, the published RTP and the casino’s terms. Many players
run the free demo of the tower rush game online a few times first, simply to see how quickly the
multiplier can move.

## Why Players Pick Tower Rush

Part of the appeal is control. Unlike a slot, where you press spin and accept whatever lands, Tower
Rush lets you choose the exact moment to bank your multiplier. Every round feels like your call, and
that sense of agency is a big reason players keep coming back to the tower rush game rather than a
purely automatic title.

The rest of the draw is practical. Rounds are short, which suits quick sessions on a phone; the
build-up is visual and easy to follow, so there is no complicated paytable to learn; entry stakes
are low, so you can play within a modest budget; and a free demo lets newcomers learn risk-free. On
top of that, Galaxsys is a recognised studio, so the tower rush online game carries the production
polish players expect from an established provider. None of this changes the underlying truth,
though - every result is random, and the appeal of the format is about enjoyment, not better odds.

## Game Mechanics

Mechanically, the loop is simple but worth understanding properly. Each floor you add nudges the
multiplier upward, while a random number generator quietly decides, at the start of the round, the
floor at which the tower will collapse. Your cash-out button is the only lever you fully control:
press it before the collapse and you keep the current multiplier; leave it too late and the round
ends with nothing.

Because that collapse point is fixed by the RNG and is independent of how the last round ended, the
tower rush game cannot be “read” or patterned. A long run of low collapses tells you nothing about
the next round. Many Galaxsys titles use a provably-fair system, where seeds let players verify that
results were not manipulated after the fact - if Tower Rush exposes this, it is worth checking so
you can confirm fairness yourself. Remember too that RTP is a long-term theoretical average measured
over millions of rounds, not a promise about any single session.

## Best Strategies and Winning Tips for India Players

First, the honest part: no strategy can change a random outcome. The collapse point is set by the
RNG, so what follows are bankroll and risk-management tips, not a method for beating the tower. Used
sensibly, they help you stay in control and make the entertainment last longer.
* Set a budget in ₹ before you start, and treat it as the most you are willing to lose for the
  session - not a target to win back.
* Decide on a session or time limit too, because the fast pace of the tower rush game makes it easy
  to play longer than you planned.
* Consider auto cash-out at a modest multiplier rather than chasing one huge floor; consistent small
  exits and rare big multipliers are two very different styles of play.
* Never chase losses by increasing your stake to “make it back” - that is how budgets disappear
  quickly.
* Practise in the free demo and learn your casino’s exact bet limits before playing for real.
* Take regular breaks; stepping away resets your judgement far better than pushing through.

There is no single “correct” approach. A cautious player might bank early and often for a steadier
ride, while another accepts more variance for the occasional large multiplier. The right balance for
India players depends entirely on personal risk tolerance - and the most valuable tip is the dullest
one: set your limits in advance and stop when you reach them, regardless of how the last few rounds
went.

## Bonuses in Tower Rush

Beyond the basic build, the tower rush game mixes in a few special floors that can shift the risk
and reward of a round the moment they appear. These are in-game features tied to the build itself -
not casino deposit bonuses - and each behaves differently. Because exact behaviour can vary between
releases, it is worth confirming the details on Galaxsys’s own game materials. What they all share
is this: they add variety and potential, but none of them removes the random collapse risk.

### Frozen Floor

The Frozen Floor acts as a safety-style feature. When it appears, it “locks” or protects part of
your build - for example securing a portion of the multiplier so a collapse does not wipe everything
you have gained. It softens the downside of an aggressive build, but it reduces risk rather than
removing it, so a poorly timed round can still end badly. Confirm the precise mechanic on the
official game sheet before relying on it.

### Temple Floor

The Temple Floor is a special high-value level that can boost the multiplier or trigger an enhanced
reward when the tower reaches it. It tends to appear rarely, which is exactly why it raises both the
potential payout and the volatility of a round. Treat it as an occasional bonus moment rather than
something to bank on, and verify any stated multiplier range before you play.

### Triple Build

Triple Build accelerates the climb - typically by adding several floors at once or applying a
stepped multiplier boost - so the multiplier rises faster than a normal build. The trade-off is that
it also brings the cash-out decision forward, leaving you less time to react. It can be exciting,
but the faster pace means discipline matters even more. Check the exact effect in Galaxsys’s
materials so you know what to expect.

##### Disclaimer

The equations and look-up tables are freely available for software implementation by IT engineers
and medical device companies.

The GLI software packages are to be used for research, education, training and validation of
implementation in software, and not for use in patient treatment.

For treatment/diagnostic purposes, please use the GLI reference equations as implemented by medical
device companies.

Accept

##### Information for each calculator

###### Spirometry

The GLI Spirometry Task Force derived continuous prediction equations and their lower limits of
normal for spirometric indices. Over 160,000 data points from 72 centres in 33 countries were shared
with the GLI. Eliminating data that could not be used (mostly missing ethnic group, some outliers)
left 97,759 records of healthy nonsmokers (55.3% females) aged 2.5–95 yrs.

Lung function data were collated and prediction equations derived using the LMS method, which allows
simultaneous modelling of the mean (mu), the coefficient of variation (sigma) and skewness (lambda)
of a distribution family.

Reference equations were derived for healthy individuals aged 3–95 yrs for Caucasians (n=57,395),
African–Americans (n=3,545), and North (n=4,992) and South East Asians (n=8,255). Forced expiratory
value in 1 s (FEV1) and forced vital capacity (FVC) between ethnic groups differed proportionally
from that in Caucasians, such that FEV1/FVC remained virtually independent of ethnic group. For
individuals not represented by these four groups, or of mixed ethnic origins, a composite equation
taken as the average of the above equations is provided to facilitate interpretation until a more
appropriate solution is developed.

Additional data from the Indian subcontinent and Arabic, Polynesian and Latin American countries, as
well as Africa will further improve these equations in the future.

Publication: [ERSJournal][1]

###### Spirometry - race-neutral equations

In response to new evidence questioning the use of race-specific reference equations for the
interpretation of lung function, the GLI has recently created race-neutral equations, GLI-Global,
which do not require race/ethnicity as an input in spirometry interpretation. These equations were
derived from the same data as the Quanjer 2012 equations, but applied inverse probability weights so
that each racial and ethnic group contribute equally to the predicted values. The use of a single
“Global” spirometry equation reflects the wide range of lung function observed within and between
populations. Given the inherent limitations of any reference equation, the use of GLI Global
equations to interpret spirometry requires careful consideration of an individual’s symptoms and
medical history when used to make clinical, employment, and insurance decisions.

To obtain race-neutral estimates of spirometry, calculated via the GLI-Global equations please
either:
* Select "race-neutral" in the Spirometry section on the web page
* Use ethnic=0 for all for individuals when using the Excel calculator or the API

[[How Do Pulmonary Function Test Filters Improve Respiratory Testing?]][97]

### [How Do Pulmonary Function Test Filters Improve Respiratory Testing?][98]

# Laboratory Equipment Manufacturer for Research & Testing

][27]

Labtron Equipment is a leading manufacturer of innovative Laboratory Equipment and Analytical
Equipment for all kinds of laboratory applications. Our laboratory equipment are compact,
energy-efficient, and durable, featuring built-in safety for versatile use. We offer a range of
laboratory equipment and analytical instruments including centrifuges, chillers, incubators, mixers,
freeze dryers, shakers, petroleum testing, water testing, airborne particle counters, biochemistry
analyzers, test chambers, automated stainers, furnaces, GC-MS, HPLC, spectrophotometers, and more,
ensuring comprehensive support for all your laboratory needs. We make sure every product meets our
high standards by carefully checking them with strict quality control measures.

We are ISO 9001:2015 Certified company and all our products comply with stringent International
Standards such as Certificate of Compliance (2014/35/EU Low Voltage Directive & 2014/32/EU Measuring
Instruments Directive), Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) System, ISO 13485:2016, ISO 9001:2015, EC
Declaration of Conformity (In Vitro Diagnostic Medical Devices Directive 98/79/EC) and Certificate
of Conformity (European Pressure Equipment Directive 2014/68/EU).

We can also provide IQ, OQ, and PQ Certifications with our products.

[

Labtron offers a wide variety of laboratory equipment that satisfy the diverse needs of scientific

controlled conditions.

# Mobile Lung Function Testing Service

# In-house, in-home or nominated location. We utilise state-of-the art lung function testing
# equipment and a wealth of experience and passion to service you and your patients

If you are looking for an Australian and New Zealand Society of Respiratory Scientist
(ANZSRS) Certified Respiratory Function Scientist (CRFS) than look no further. 

I provide a very unique service offering which can easily be tailored - whether it be simple in-home
lung function testing for patients or more complex needs to meet the needs of savvy consultant
physicians or agile organisations. 

At the heart of all we do is modern, state-of-the art, well-maintained equipment which is staffed by
extremely experienced, and friendly staff. A robust booking platform is available to book a number
of varied services to suit your needs, or the needs of your clients and/or practice. 

Our service offerings include direct booking from those wanting to gain a better understanding of
how their lungs are functioning. Additionally, our services can be tailored for consultant
physicians who are wanting access to faster and more timely results for their patients by having a
mobile lung function scientist visit before, during or after physician appointments.  Further,
tailored services to conduct medical assessments on behalf of organisations is very possible. 

Our core business is working directly with Consultant Physicians in-house during consultation times
to add clinical value to busy medical practices. As well as adding an important clinical service
offering to your practice we also add an extra revenue source to your practice.

Ask for more information

###### reception staff to organise a Video Consultation (Telehealth). 
###### 
###### We welcome new patients to our practice.
###### 
###### Masks are no longer required when attending appointments unless you have cold or flu like
###### symptoms.

# Spirometry simplified

We are your primary partner in spirometry. We know how vital your work is and that real people with
real needs are reliant on your care. It reminds us of the important role that quality plays in our
work and in people’s health and wellbeing. It’s why we strive to make your work and your patients’
health journeys easier.

[Explore our journey in healthcare][32]

## Expert respiratory health care in the palm of your hand

## Engineering simplicity

### The more accurate your diagnosis, the better your care

Better health outcomes begin with an accurate diagnosis. It’s the key tool in determining the
treatments and level of care a patient will receive. We have spent nearly half a century developing
high-quality spirometers to create a world where patients receive the most accurate diagnoses for
their lung issues.

## Company Profile

Mofolo Medical Technology dedicated in development, production and export of advanced medical
consumable products.

## About Factory

Occupies an area of 36,000 square meters, a modern purification plant area of 5,000 square meters,
and a total of 350 employees.

## About Products

Mainly including drainage series, respiratory anesthesiaseries, urinary series, medical catheter
series and medical sponge series.

## New Products

[
[Disposable Jackson Table Frame Sponge Positioner Kits (3)]

## 01

][185]

### Disposable Jackson Table Frame Sponge Positioner Kits

Mofolo’s Disposable Jackson Table Frame Sponge Positioner Kit features a layer of breathable,
skin-friendly on pressure-bearing components and torso lift cover for safer patient repositioning to
minimize pressure injury developments.

[
[M.F.L Positioning Pad Kit (3)]

## 02

][186]

### M.F.L Positioning Pad Kit

Mofolo’s new M.F.L positioning pad kit. Composed of breathable, soft and moisture-wicking materials.
Better wrap the patient to prevent skin breakdown and pressure injury during and after surgery and
patient rehabilitation. It is more helpful in preventing Hospital Acquired Pressure Injuries
(HAPIs).

[
[Shoulder Stabilization Kit (1)]

## 03

][187]

### Shoulder Stabilization Kit

Mofolo’s Shoulder Stabilization Kit is a medical device used to fix and protect the shoulder joint,
and is commonly used to treat diseases such as shoulder dislocation, rotator cuff injury, frozen
shoulder, etc. It is very important to use the shoulder fixation brace correctly to ensure the
effectiveness of the treatment and avoid complications.

[
[Prone Head Positioner Device (3)]

## 04

][188]

### Prone Head Positioner Device

Prone Head Positioning Device (HPD) is for use with patients who need to be placed in a position for
an operation. It is designed to support not only the head, but also ensure that ET Tube is
positioned and supported and also the patient’s face can be monitored by the clinician via the
viewing mirror. The head position device is lightweight and latex free.

[

### Disposable Head Supports

Provide support, stability, elevation and safe alignment of head and neck.Support and protect
sensitive facial features.Several products are designed to accommodate an endotracheal tube.

Disposable Suction Swab Sponge is Safe, soft, sterile . we can do flavored or unflavored. The oral
swabs are using for the daily oral care and household supplies, which can also be used for adult
oral care and child oral care also for pets oral care.

Mofolo disposable suction oral care swab sponge/ toothbrush can be used for unconscious patient in
ICU. This suction swab can be easily connected to standard suction lines and help remove plaque,
debris and oral secretions. Possibility of simultaneous cleansing of the mouth, rinsing and suction
Lifts debris and mucus from teeth and gums.

data, diagnosis is delayed and treatment is reactive. For many patients, the first real encounter
isn’t in clinic—it’s in the emergency room.

monitoring

PFT Solutions][66]**

Our Software
ComPAS2 is the most advanced, customer-driven software available in the PFT space with flexible
integrations that take you where you want to go. Unleash your potential with ComPAS2.
[Learn more][67]
Our Products
Long lasting. Reliable. Accurate. Intuitive. These are the words that come up again and again with
our customers. If you are tired of downtime in your lab and waiting on the phone to get back up and
running, click to find out more.
[Learn More][68]
Our Mission
Morgan Scientific could be called ‘the listening PFT company.’ Nowhere else can customers get such a
warm invitation to influence product development in a way that gets results. So many customer ideas
are on display in ComPAS2; the process is always evolving and collaborative ideas are welcome.
[Learn more][69]
[Morgan Scientific]

## Don't be ruled by technology; own it

ComPAS2 is enterprise software that offers unique PFT adaptability and effortless control with
unmatched concierge style support. We are the perfect partner for your specific needs with IT
know-how and a personal touch.

ComPAS2 Task Manager allows for superior remote interpretation, workflow optimization, and is a
flexible PFT software solution like no other.
* Minimal Keystrokes, so you can focus on the patient
* Several remote interpretation options to set you free
* Optimal workflow enhancement with ComPAS2 Task Manager
* Limitless reporting capabilities and customized predicted sets
* 100% Success with EMR Interfacing
* Data management to track and trend historical patient results

## 15 years of trust in the ndd EasyOne solutions

Dr. Rabahi, a leading pulmonologist from Brazil, talks about his long-standing experience with the
ndd product family —and why he continues to trust them in his practice after more than 15 years

“I have confidence with my exams. I can trust in the results, and this helps me care better for my
patients,” he says.

[ Get inspired by our customers—read their journeys to success.][123]
[Dr Rabahi - ndd EasyOne happy customer]

## Empower your team to deliver exceptional respiratory care

Choosing the best spirometry solution starts with understanding your practice’s needs. From
user-friendly designs to advanced diagnostic capabilities, our spirometers are built for precision
and reliability. Let us help you find the perfect match.
[ Find the right EasyOne spirometer][124]
[Doctor using an EasyOne spirometer]

## Spirometry testing for your practice

Enhance patient care and unlock a new revenue stream with EasyOne spirometers. Accurate and reliable
lung function testing helps improve early diagnosis, treatment decisions, and impacts patient
outcomes—while also creating financial opportunities for your practice.
[ See the ROI of spirometry][125]
[spirometry roi]

## Breaking the cycle of late COPD diagnosis

Millions of people live with undiagnosed or mismanaged COPD, missing the opportunity to receive
treatment that could improve their quality of life. By integrating spirometry into routine care, we
can identify COPD sooner and help patients breathe easier.
[ Learn more about the impact of early diagnosis][126]
[worldwide copd]

## Precise performance with the EasyOne PFT solutions.

ndd Medical Technologies offers innovative, easy-to-use pulmonary function testing instruments that
help clinicians diagnose and treat lung disease with unmatched precision. The EasyOne spirometry and
complete pulmonary function testing products are the most consistent and user-friendly lung function
testing equipment made today.

# A Global Leader in Spirometry Excellence.
# Your Breath, Our Innovation.

# MIR - Medical International Research

### Italian excellence around the world

We develop premium medical equipment, including Spirometers and Oximeters, for professional and
personal use to manage and prevent respiratory conditions.

## Medical International Research is a world leading company in Spirometry, Oximetry and Medical
## Solutions

Present in more than 100 countries worldwide, MIR is making its most innovative technology available
to healthcare professionals and their patients in the pneumology sector by pairing a series of new,
reliable, and ready–to–use smartphone–compatible Smart devices with its professional line of
products to help facilitate more comprehensive personal health monitoring.With over **30 years of
experience**, today MIR makes its products available in more than **100 Countries**, facilitating
the **measurement** and **management of respiratory health** internationally.

The several certifications obtained over time (**FDA** for the United States, **NMPA** for
China, **ANVISA** for Brazil, **COFEPRIS** for Mexico, **Health Canada** for Canada, and many
others) have played and continue to play an indispensable role in making MIR products not only
accessible worldwide but also compliant with the **highest quality standards**.

Additionally, MIR is internationally recognized for the uniqueness of its **patented products**.

[hands holding a virtual image of lungs]

Thanks to a comprehensive and integrated portfolio that combines **professional-use** devices
with **personal-use** devices, MIR extends the ability to monitor respiratory functions beyond the
walls of **hospitals** and **medical centers**, promoting **home monitoring** and a **proactive
approach** to respiratory health management.

MIR is not just a supplier of high-quality equipment, but your **ally** in your fight against
respiratory conditions.

## MIR solutions in respiratory care

Our internationally certified and recognized products perfectly address the rapidly growing global
trend of new **public-private** and **home healthcare** models.

The accuracy and reliability of spirometry are now guaranteed by our company through constant
investments in **Research and Development**, which have led to the creation of advanced
high-performing products – comparable to diagnostic spirometers and PFTs – capable of meeting
current needs.

Even the **National Health Service** (NHS), the UK's national healthcare system, has positively
evaluated the advancements made by MIR in the technical-medical field, to the point of integrating
some of the most innovative solutions developed by MIR into its governance, particularly in the
implementation of virtual visits.

# A Global Leader in Spirometry Excellence.
# Your Breath, Our Innovation.

# MIR - Medical International Research

### Italian excellence around the world

We develop premium medical equipment, including Spirometers and Oximeters, for professional and
personal use to manage and prevent respiratory conditions.

## Medical International Research is a world leading company in Spirometry, Oximetry and Medical
## Solutions

Present in more than 100 countries worldwide, MIR is making its most innovative technology available
to healthcare professionals and their patients in the pneumology sector by pairing a series of new,
reliable, and ready–to–use smartphone–compatible Smart devices with its professional line of
products to help facilitate more comprehensive personal health monitoring.With over **30 years of
experience**, today MIR makes its products available in more than **100 Countries**, facilitating
the **measurement** and **management of respiratory health** internationally.

The several certifications obtained over time (**FDA** for the United States, **NMPA** for
China, **ANVISA** for Brazil, **COFEPRIS** for Mexico, **Health Canada** for Canada, and many
others) have played and continue to play an indispensable role in making MIR products not only
accessible worldwide but also compliant with the **highest quality standards**.

Additionally, MIR is internationally recognized for the uniqueness of its **patented products**.

[hands holding a virtual image of lungs]

Thanks to a comprehensive and integrated portfolio that combines **professional-use** devices
with **personal-use** devices, MIR extends the ability to monitor respiratory functions beyond the
walls of **hospitals** and **medical centers**, promoting **home monitoring** and a **proactive
approach** to respiratory health management.

MIR is not just a supplier of high-quality equipment, but your **ally** in your fight against
respiratory conditions.

## MIR solutions in respiratory care

Our internationally certified and recognized products perfectly address the rapidly growing global
trend of new **public-private** and **home healthcare** models.

The accuracy and reliability of spirometry are now guaranteed by our company through constant
investments in **Research and Development**, which have led to the creation of advanced
high-performing products – comparable to diagnostic spirometers and PFTs – capable of meeting
current needs.

Even the **National Health Service** (NHS), the UK's national healthcare system, has positively
evaluated the advancements made by MIR in the technical-medical field, to the point of integrating
some of the most innovative solutions developed by MIR into its governance, particularly in the
implementation of virtual visits.

manufacturing EEG (electroencephalograph) machines since 1977.

Patient Monitor

sign parameter which makes them ultra portable to feature packed high-end multiparameter models.

Clinical Diagnostics

BCA is not just a standard photometer; it is a true new generation semi-automatic biochemistry
analyzer capable of performing Routine Biochemistry, Hormonal assay, Electrolytes etc.

Why Choose Us?

RMS driven by core values of integrity, quality, commitment and innovation, and renowned for
excellence in what we do, RMS is more than a company. Recorders & Medicare Systems Pvt Ltd (RMS) is

Indian Subcontinent. Polyrite, the first Indian Polygraph was developed within the first year of
inception in 1975 followed by EEG in the year 1977, wherein we became a part of a select group of 7
EEG manufacturers in the world. Our R&D is recognized by the government of India since 1978.

We have 17 regional offices that are manned by over 150 Sales & Service engineers. RMS has also
extended its market in SAARC region, East Africa, Middle East and Europe through dealers and
strategic partners.

### Science Lab Export | Premium Educational & Scientific Lab Equipment Manufacturer - Science Lab
### Export is a leading global manufacturer of premium Educational Lab Equipment, Scientific
### Instruments, and Training Tools. Serving 65+ countries.

**Empowering Global Science Education** **Science Lab Export** is a premier manufacturer and
supplier of high-quality scientific instruments and educational laboratory solutions. With a proven
track record of successfully delivering projects alongside our trusted dealers in **over 65
countries**, we have established a global reputation as a professional, reliable, and innovative
partner for institutions worldwide.

**Transforming Classrooms with Hands-On Learning** We believe that effective science education
requires moving beyond the textbook. We manufacture robust, functional, and interactive educational
lab equipment that allows students to perform real experiments, observe concrete results, and grasp
complex theories with ease. Every instrument we design is highly durable, user-friendly, and
maintenance-free, ensuring that schools, colleges, and technical institutions can focus entirely on
teaching rather than equipment upkeep.

**Our Comprehensive Manufacturing Capabilities** As a leading scientific instrument manufacturer
based in India, we produce a vast array of equipment adhering strictly to international quality
standards. Our core manufacturing divisions include:
* **School Science & Core Academics:** Complete, curriculum-aligned equipment for Physics,
  Chemistry, Biology, and General High School Science labs.
* **Essential Laboratory Instrumentation:** Professional-grade educational microscopes, precision
  laboratory glassware, and durable scientific plasticware.

Committed to innovation and uncompromising quality, Science Lab Export proudly equips educators and
students across the globe to make science learning interactive, engaging, and result-oriented.Our
**Educational Lab Equipment** for Science Labs cover **High School Physics Lab Equipment,
Educational Biology Lab Equipments, Educational Laboratory Microscopes, Engineering Educational
Equipments, Scientific Lab Plasticware, School Science Lab Instruments**, among many others. Each
product we produce is made to be user-friendly, highly durable, and maintenance-free to ensure that
schools, colleges, and technical institutions can concentrate on teaching and learning instead of
equipment maintenance.

Committed strongly towards innovation, quality, and international standards, Science Lab Export is
facilitating educators and students across the world to make science learning interactive,
fun-filled, and result-oriented.

We are well-known for manufacturing high-quality **Educational Lab Equipments** that render learning
hands-on, functional, and interactive. Our **laboratory equipment** for science is such that
students do not merely read about experiments; rather, they can perform them, see the results, and
learn the underlying concepts. This way, the conventional classroom experience is revolutionized,
with learners finding it simpler to learn complicated theories and concepts

### Export is a leading global manufacturer of premium Educational Lab Equipment, Scientific
### Instruments, and Training Tools. Serving 65+ countries.

**Empowering Global Science Education** **Science Lab Export** is a premier manufacturer and
supplier of high-quality scientific instruments and educational laboratory solutions. With a proven
track record of successfully delivering projects alongside our trusted dealers in **over 65
countries**, we have established a global reputation as a professional, reliable, and innovative
partner for institutions worldwide.

**Transforming Classrooms with Hands-On Learning** We believe that effective science education
requires moving beyond the textbook. We manufacture robust, functional, and interactive educational
lab equipment that allows students to perform real experiments, observe concrete results, and grasp
complex theories with ease. Every instrument we design is highly durable, user-friendly, and
maintenance-free, ensuring that schools, colleges, and technical institutions can focus entirely on
teaching rather than equipment upkeep.

**Our Comprehensive Manufacturing Capabilities** As a leading scientific instrument manufacturer
based in India, we produce a vast array of equipment adhering strictly to international quality
standards. Our core manufacturing divisions include:
* **School Science & Core Academics:** Complete, curriculum-aligned equipment for Physics,
  Chemistry, Biology, and General High School Science labs.
* **Essential Laboratory Instrumentation:** Professional-grade educational microscopes, precision
  laboratory glassware, and durable scientific plasticware.

Committed to innovation and uncompromising quality, Science Lab Export proudly equips educators and
students across the globe to make science learning interactive, engaging, and result-oriented.Our
**Educational Lab Equipment** for Science Labs cover **High School Physics Lab Equipment,
Educational Biology Lab Equipments, Educational Laboratory Microscopes, Engineering Educational
Equipments, Scientific Lab Plasticware, School Science Lab Instruments**, among many others. Each
product we produce is made to be user-friendly, highly durable, and maintenance-free to ensure that
schools, colleges, and technical institutions can concentrate on teaching and learning instead of
equipment maintenance.

Committed strongly towards innovation, quality, and international standards, Science Lab Export is
facilitating educators and students across the world to make science learning interactive,
fun-filled, and result-oriented.

We are well-known for manufacturing high-quality **Educational Lab Equipments** that render learning
hands-on, functional, and interactive. Our **laboratory equipment** for science is such that
students do not merely read about experiments; rather, they can perform them, see the results, and
learn the underlying concepts. This way, the conventional classroom experience is revolutionized,
with learners finding it simpler to learn complicated theories and concepts

## About SDI Diagnostics

SDI Diagnostics, Inc. was founded in 1978. We have always worked by a single motto - We value our
customers and promise to never take them for granted. Our products are the best and so is our
customer service. We are proud that our filters are made here in New England.

CALL US 1-800-678-5782.

[More][64]

## Why Choose Us

### Customer Service

We are very proud of our customer service. Our dealers and end users all tell us that we “get it”
and that there are none better. The customer service team knows what it takes to make customers want
to come back, and they deliver it day in and day out.

### Technical Support

Our technical support team is ready to help with any technical concerns that come up. From repairing
instruments to providing telephonic in-services, they do it all.

### Sales

Sales support is at the heart of our relationships with the marketplace. Our team is without peer
when it comes to product knowledge and a deep understanding of what it takes to help evaluate SDI
products. They provide a level of support that every customer wants, and that our customers have
come to expect.

## Setting the standard in respiratory diagnostics

### Customer Service

Our customer and technical service departments provide the best product support in the industry.
Whether you need help placing an order or have questions about a product; we are here to help.

### Quality Products

We offer the best quality products at the lowest prices, and we stand behind the products we sell.
When dealing with SDI Diagnostics, you can be assured you will be receiving the best value in the
industry. SDI is dedicated to offering the best quality, that is why most of our products are Made
in the USA at our facility located in Massachusetts.

### Industry Compliance

All of our disposables are registered with the FDA and our filters meet ATS/ERS standards with a
cross-contamination efficiency of 99.999%. The use of our products will not affect your spirometer
warranty.

### ¿Qué tipo de productos ofrece Sibelmed?

En el área de respiratorio, Sibelmed ofrece una gama de espirómetros así como polígrafos
respiratorios para el diagnostico del sueño y la terapia postural.

En el área de audiometría, es fabricante de audiómetros y una amplia gama cabinas audiométricas.

### ¿Es Sibelmed una empresa española?

Sí, Sibelmed es una empresa que se fundó en Barcelona en 1980. Todos los productos de Sibelmed se
fabrican en España.
Su [Vincispin][119] trovi slot, live dealer e bonus trasparenti; verifica licenza, RTP e tempi di

### ¿Dónde se pueden comprar los productos de Sibelmed?

Los productos de Sibelmed se pueden comprar directamente contactando con su equipo comercial, así
como a través de su amplia red nacional e internacional de distribuidores autorizados.

### ¿Sibelmed ofrece soporte técnico para sus productos?

Sí, Sibelmed es un fabricante que ofrece un soporte técnico y servicio post-venta integral en todos
sus productos a través de su Servicio Técnico Oficial.

### ¿Los productos de Sibelmed están aprobados por las autoridades sanitarias?

Sí. Todos los productos de Sibelmed son productos sanitarios que cumplen estrictamente con los
estándares de calidad y seguridad establecidos por las normativas sanitarias europeas, así como las
de los países en los que se comercializan.

Wenn zügige Auszahlungen und verlässlicher Support wichtig sind, passt [pelican casino][122]. Hohe
Volatilität trifft auf solide Titel für längere Sessions. Vergleiche Bonusbedingungen und
Auszahlungszeiten für optimale Ergebnisse.

### ¿Cuál es el enfoque principal de Sibelmed en el campo de la medicina del sueño?

El enfoque principal de Sibelmed es ofrecer soluciones innovadoras y de alta calidad para el
diagnóstico y tratamiento de trastornos respiratorios relacionados con el sueño, como la apnea del
sueño. Sibelmed trabaja en estrecha colaboración con profesionales médicos y especialistas en sueño
para desarrollar productos y soluciones que mejoren la calidad de vida de los pacientes.

### ¿Qué tecnologías utiliza Sibelmed en sus productos?

Sibelmed utiliza tecnologías de vanguardia que permiten a los especialistas obtener información
precisa y detallada sobre la salud pulmonar y calidad del sueño de los pacientes.

### ¿Sibelmed ofrece formación y educación para profesionales médicos?

Sí. Sibelmed dispone de un amplio material divulgativo para facilitar una formación continuada a los
profesionales y ofrece cursos sobre el diagnóstico y tratamiento de trastornos respiratorios
relacionados con la espirometria y el sueño, así como sobre el uso de sus productos.

En el área de respiratorio, Sibelmed ofrece una gama de espirómetros así como polígrafos
respiratorios para el diagnostico del sueño y la terapia postural.

En el área de audiometría, es fabricante de audiómetros y una amplia gama cabinas audiométricas.

### ¿Es Sibelmed una empresa española?

Sí, Sibelmed es una empresa que se fundó en Barcelona en 1980. Todos los productos de Sibelmed se
fabrican en España.

### ¿Dónde se pueden comprar los productos de Sibelmed?

Los productos de Sibelmed se pueden comprar directamente contactando con su equipo comercial, así
como a través de su amplia red nacional e internacional de distribuidores autorizados.

### ¿Sibelmed ofrece soporte técnico para sus productos?

Sí, Sibelmed es un fabricante que ofrece un soporte técnico y servicio post-venta integral en todos

### ¿Los productos de Sibelmed están aprobados por las autoridades sanitarias?

Sí. Todos los productos de Sibelmed son productos sanitarios que cumplen estrictamente con los
estándares de calidad y seguridad establecidos por las normativas sanitarias europeas, así como las
de los países en los que se comercializan.

### ¿Cuál es el enfoque principal de Sibelmed en el campo de la medicina del sueño?

El enfoque principal de Sibelmed es ofrecer soluciones innovadoras y de alta calidad para el
diagnóstico y tratamiento de trastornos respiratorios relacionados con el sueño, como la apnea del
sueño. Sibelmed trabaja en estrecha colaboración con profesionales médicos y especialistas en sueño
para desarrollar productos y soluciones que mejoren la calidad de vida de los pacientes.

### ¿Qué tecnologías utiliza Sibelmed en sus productos?

Sibelmed utiliza tecnologías de vanguardia que permiten a los especialistas obtener información
precisa y detallada sobre la salud pulmonar y calidad del sueño de los pacientes.

### ¿Sibelmed ofrece formación y educación para profesionales médicos?

Sí. Sibelmed dispone de un amplio material divulgativo para facilitar una formación continuada a los
profesionales y ofrece cursos sobre el diagnóstico y tratamiento de trastornos respiratorios
relacionados con la espirometria y el sueño, así como sobre el uso de sus productos.

Booth: Q18
Syntron Electromechanical Feeders
Syntron Material Handling
Syntron® MF heavy-duty electromechanical feeders are the heavyweights of bulk material handling,
used for higher-capacity requirements. The eight heavy-duty models handle capacities from 100 to
4,000 tons per hour.*

Syntron heavy-duty electromechanical feeders combine extra structural strength with durable
components. The deep wing plates form a bridge between the inlet and discharge suspension supports,
providing extra strength for years of dependable service. Standard troughs feature unitized
weldments—one-piece, completely welded units for greater strength. Troughs are also available with
bolt-together construction for tunnel installations or other confined areas. MF heavy-duty
electromechanical feeders are two-mass, spring-connected, and sub-resonant-tuned. The exciter unit
is connected to the trough via corrosion-resistant polymeric drive springs, which reduce vertical
stroke while amplifying stroke in the direction of material flow. This feature creates straight line
motion, providing maximum material flow rate and feeder capacity. Syntron feeders also utilize
custom-engineered electromechanical vibrators. These vibrators feature an L10 life expectancy of
over 100,000 hours in normal operation, and they allow quick removal via access from both sides of
the feeder or from the bottom. Attachments for safety cables are included on all Syntron feeders.

*Based on dry sand weighing 100 pounds per cubic foot. Capacities vary depending on material
characteristics, material density, trough length and width, trough liner type, feeder installation,
skirt boards, and hopper transitions.
][37] [
Exposibram 2026
Booth: Q18
Syntron SyntroFlo Cone Crusher Feeder
Syntron Material Handling
The SyntroFlo cone crusher loading feeder by Syntron is a MF two-mass tuned direct drive vibratory
feeder with an engineered discharge uniquely designed for equal distribution of product. The trough
including the discharge is fully lined to account for wear. Like traditionally designed feeders, it
is suspension mounted, which can be easily integrated into a trolley system allowing it to be moved
out of the way for crusher maintenance. In side-by-side installations of a feeder-plus-rotary
distributor versus a SyntroFlo cone crusher loading feeder directly feeding the crusher, the
SyntroFlo unit delivered superior, cone-friendly performance. The uniform distribution provided by
the SyntroFlo unit increased curser manganese life and yielded more cubicle-formed product.

SyntroFlo is available in three standard sizes for tertiary crusher applications: STF-3F, STF-4F,
and STF-5F. In addition, we are developing the STF-3C, STF-4C, and STF-5C for secondary crushing
applications. Both designs work with 300 HP, 400 HP, and 500 HP cones, respectively. These designs
will allow the SyntroFlo unit to be a cost-effective solution for feeding your cone crusher
equipment. We can build a custom cone crushing feeder unit for larger and smaller applications upon
request.

Syntron Electromechanical Feeders
Syntron Material Handling
Syntron® MF heavy-duty electromechanical feeders are the heavyweights of bulk material handling,
used for higher-capacity requirements. The eight heavy-duty models handle capacities from 100 to
4,000 tons per hour.*

Syntron heavy-duty electromechanical feeders combine extra structural strength with durable
components. The deep wing plates form a bridge between the inlet and discharge suspension supports,
providing extra strength for years of dependable service. Standard troughs feature unitized
weldments—one-piece, completely welded units for greater strength. Troughs are also available with
bolt-together construction for tunnel installations or other confined areas. MF heavy-duty
electromechanical feeders are two-mass, spring-connected, and sub-resonant-tuned. The exciter unit
is connected to the trough via corrosion-resistant polymeric drive springs, which reduce vertical
stroke while amplifying stroke in the direction of material flow. This feature creates straight line
motion, providing maximum material flow rate and feeder capacity. Syntron feeders also utilize
custom-engineered electromechanical vibrators. These vibrators feature an L10 life expectancy of
over 100,000 hours in normal operation, and they allow quick removal via access from both sides of
the feeder or from the bottom. Attachments for safety cables are included on all Syntron feeders.

*Based on dry sand weighing 100 pounds per cubic foot. Capacities vary depending on material
characteristics, material density, trough length and width, trough liner type, feeder installation,
skirt boards, and hopper transitions.
][37] [

Syntron SyntroFlo Cone Crusher Feeder
Syntron Material Handling
The SyntroFlo cone crusher loading feeder by Syntron is a MF two-mass tuned direct drive vibratory
feeder with an engineered discharge uniquely designed for equal distribution of product. The trough
including the discharge is fully lined to account for wear. Like traditionally designed feeders, it
is suspension mounted, which can be easily integrated into a trolley system allowing it to be moved
out of the way for crusher maintenance. In side-by-side installations of a feeder-plus-rotary
distributor versus a SyntroFlo cone crusher loading feeder directly feeding the crusher, the
SyntroFlo unit delivered superior, cone-friendly performance. The uniform distribution provided by
the SyntroFlo unit increased curser manganese life and yielded more cubicle-formed product.

SyntroFlo is available in three standard sizes for tertiary crusher applications: STF-3F, STF-4F,
and STF-5F. In addition, we are developing the STF-3C, STF-4C, and STF-5C for secondary crushing
applications. Both designs work with 300 HP, 400 HP, and 500 HP cones, respectively. These designs
will allow the SyntroFlo unit to be a cost-effective solution for feeding your cone crusher
equipment. We can build a custom cone crushing feeder unit for larger and smaller applications upon
request.

## MIR - Medical International Research

### Italian excellence around the world

##### We develop premium medical equipment, including Spirometers and Oximeters, for professional
##### and personal use to manage and prevent respiratory conditions.

[
][30]

### Medical International Research is a world leading company in Spirometry, Oximetry and Medical
### Solutions

Present in more than 100 countries worldwide, MIR is making its most innovative technology available
to healthcare professionals and their patients in the pneumology sector by pairing a series of new,
reliable, and ready–to–use smartphone–compatible Smart devices with its professional line of
products to help facilitate more comprehensive personal health monitoring.With over **30 years of
experience**, today MIR makes its products available in more than **100 Countries**, facilitating
the **measurement** and **management of respiratory health** internationally.

The several certifications obtained over time (**FDA** for the United States, **NMPA** for China,
**ANVISA** for Brazil, **COFEPRIS** for Mexico, **Health Canada** for Canada, and many others) have
played and continue to play an indispensable role in making MIR products not only accessible
worldwide but also compliant with the **highest quality standards**.

Additionally, MIR is internationally recognized for the uniqueness of its **patented products**.

Thanks to a comprehensive and integrated portfolio that combines **professional-use** devices with
**personal-use** devices, MIR extends the ability to monitor respiratory functions beyond the walls
of **hospitals** and **medical centers**, promoting **home monitoring** and a **proactive approach**
to respiratory health management.

MIR is not just a supplier of high-quality equipment, but your **ally** in your fight against
respiratory conditions.

## MIR - Medical International Research

### Italian excellence around the world

##### We develop premium medical equipment, including Spirometers and Oximeters, for professional
##### and personal use to manage and prevent respiratory conditions.

[
][30]

### Medical International Research is a world leading company in Spirometry, Oximetry and Medical
### Solutions

Present in more than 100 countries worldwide, MIR is making its most innovative technology available
to healthcare professionals and their patients in the pneumology sector by pairing a series of new,
reliable, and ready–to–use smartphone–compatible Smart devices with its professional line of
products to help facilitate more comprehensive personal health monitoring.With over **30 years of
experience**, today MIR makes its products available in more than **100 Countries**, facilitating
the **measurement** and **management of respiratory health** internationally.

The several certifications obtained over time (**FDA** for the United States, **NMPA** for China,
**ANVISA** for Brazil, **COFEPRIS** for Mexico, **Health Canada** for Canada, and many others) have
played and continue to play an indispensable role in making MIR products not only accessible
worldwide but also compliant with the **highest quality standards**.

Additionally, MIR is internationally recognized for the uniqueness of its **patented products**.

Thanks to a comprehensive and integrated portfolio that combines **professional-use** devices with
**personal-use** devices, MIR extends the ability to monitor respiratory functions beyond the walls
of **hospitals** and **medical centers**, promoting **home monitoring** and a **proactive approach**
to respiratory health management.

MIR is not just a supplier of high-quality equipment, but your **ally** in your fight against
respiratory conditions.

It was a pleasure for us to collaborate with you for the return of the material.

Very clear communication and friendly to collaborate with to close the study.

We want to thank you for all your efforts throughout 2024. Your contributions are so valuable to the

partnership and support throughout the year. Your contributions have been invaluable to our shared
success, and we look forward to continuing our collaboration in 2025! Thank you once again for your
amazing support and commitment!

Throughout the year, I had the chance to collaborate with two of Woodley’s managers, Katie and
Kirsten. Both of them consistently demonstrated a friendly and approachable demeanour. They excel in
communication and uphold accountability. They were always available and provided timely assistance
with project requirements, particularly in urgent situations. They even helped us save part of the
sponsor's budget by identifying a suitable alternative. I am extremely satisfied and would gladly
work with Woodley again on future projects if the opportunity arises.

Have been impressed with Katie's project management when she took over the project. She's been very
responsive to all queries and requests I have sent to her.

getting equipment back. Alex and the team were proactive and tried everything they could to push the
team and get a resolution. There communication and collaboration with myself was excellent and
always came back to me with suggestions and how I could help push things. I knew I could email and
ask any questions and would receive answers even when Alex was away, someone was there to help with
the studies and the challenges.

Communication was good. Friendly approachable team. The only area I really worked on was the
collection of the machines, this seemed to work well from Woodley's side - it was our own side that
had the issues!

I am absolutely happy with services Woodley provides. All processes are very transparent, we never
had any troubles with equipment provided, timelines or logistics. Undoubtedly, that these advantages
are multiplied with perfect communication: it is a pleasure working with you! Woodley will be my
first choice for further studies.

I only worked with very competent Woodley PMs. Even when there was an issue, the PMs always tried to
solve it as quickly as possible, keeping up the communication.

*Project Manager, Large Pharmaceutical*

I really appreciate the swift and professional communication Woodley provides. I also love how
Woodley is a partner - shows this always by working with us. I never feel like we cannot come
together to figure out something to find a solution that works for Woodley and ourselves.

*Contracts Associate, DCT Specialists*

Katie was phenomenal and truly an asset to get these trials closed out. Katie truly is a star!

*Project Manager, Global Laboratory Organisation.*

Woodley Trial Solutions estimated timelines for purchasing and delivering the other supplies were
slightly better than the other vendors, and the communication went very smoothly with Woodley.

Thank you very much for your support!

*Project Manager, Global CRO*

The Woodley team, and in particular the Project Manager (Kirsten Pendlebury) were extremely
efficient, making the whole process both simple and smooth - despite us needing to have the
equipment picked up and delivered from and to different sites.

The communication was excellent, with response times to queries very speedy. We were kept in the
loop the whole time so that we could easily track when to expect the pick up/delivery of our
